title: Wilted Kenyan Pak Choi Bake
description: A resinous, crumbly, kid-friendly Kenyan dish featuring pak choi, mantecare-emulsified and Mediterranean friendly. Enjoy this as a comforting meal any time of the day.
instructions: Rinse the pak choi and trim the ends.
Cut the pak choi in half lengthwise and place it in a baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the suet, flour, and mantecare emulsifier until well combined.
Pour the mixture evenly over the pak choi, making sure each piece is coated.
Sprinkle salt and black pepper to taste.
Drizzle olive oil over the top for extra flavor.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top.
Return to the oven for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
